s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 4 long ropes and twist into pretzels. Dip in 1L water simmering with 3 tbsp bicarb soda, salt and bake at 220C for 15 minutes. Serve with butter and hot mustard.
Mash 200g ripe brie with 50g soft butter, 1 tsp paprika, half a finely diced onion and a splash of beer. Serve with sliced rye bread and radishes.

m.note: the family recipe from the old country
m.how: Pound 4 pork steaks thin. Crumb in flour, 2 eggs and 150g breadcrumbs and pan-fry in butter and oil for 3 minutes a side. Serve with 500g potato salad and lemon wedges.

w.how: Toss 4 sliced apples with 60g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 60g sultanas. Roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Dust with icing sugar and serve with cream.

d.how: Chill 8 bottles of German lager and pour into steins. Mix apple juice with soda water for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
